text: Level three, question six: pipe A fills a tank in four minutes and pipe B empties a full tank in six minutes; starting with an empty tank, they are opened alternately for one minute each, A first; when is the tank full? Question seven: pipes A and B fill a tank in twenty-four and thirty-two minutes; both are opened together; after how many minutes should B be closed so that the tank is full in eighteen minutes? Question eight: pipes A and B fill a tank in twenty and thirty minutes, and pipe C empties a full tank in fifteen minutes; A and B are opened on an empty tank, and C is opened six minutes later; find the total time to fill the tank.
